This is very close to $43.001$.

Now calculate for $t=1200$:

$1200^{1.4} = (2 \cdot 600)^{1.4} = 2^{1.4} \cdot 600^{1.4} \approx 2.639 \cdot 7751.5 \approx 20457.5$
$g = 0.005547 \cdot 20457.5 \approx 113.48$.

Alternatively, using the ratio:
$g(1200) = g(600) \cdot (1200/600)^{1.4} = 43.001 \cdot 2^{1.4} \approx 43.001 \cdot 2.639 \approx 113.48$.

The rule is $g \approx 0.005547 \cdot t^{1.4}$.
